For BioModels matching "glucose regulation", do COPASI and Tellurium agree on
the time-course dynamics — and which models diverge or fail to load in one engine?

decisions.title: Why do most curated glucose models fail to load in both engines (missing SED-ML)? Recover them?

decisions.title: Which models genuinely disagree vs. merely fail to load?
decisions.detail: The load-failure diagnosis (missing SED-ML) is inferred from an identical exception message across all 4 failures, not independently verified per model; no model in this run has yet shown genuine numerical disagreement.
